verses.text: The Proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a father glad, and a foolish son [is] the grief of his mother.

segments.text: The Proverbs of Solomon: A wise son makes a father glad, and a foolish son [is] the grief of his mother.

verses.text: The treasures of wickedness will not bring gain, and righteousness delivers from death.

verses.text: YHWH will not let the righteous soul go hungry, and the desire of the wicked ones He thrusts away.

verses.text: The one making slack [his] hand becomes poor, and the hand of the diligent ones makes rich.

verses.text: A wise heart receives commandments, and foolish lips will be thrown down.

verses.text: The one walking in integrity walks securely, and the one twisting his ways will be known.
